# HyperOS AOD Mod **The HyperOS Always-on Display and Lock Screen Editor with every feature unlocked on all devices.** [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Mods-Center/HyperOS-AOD?style=for-the-badge&label=release&color=0a84ff)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-AOD/releases/latest) [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/Mods-Center/HyperOS-AOD/total?style=for-the-badge&color=30d158)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-AOD/releases) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Mods-Center/HyperOS-AOD?style=for-the-badge&color=ffd60a)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-AOD/stargazers) [![Telegram](https://img.shields.io/badge/Telegram-channel-26A5E4?style=for-the-badge&logo=telegram&logoColor=white)](https://t.me/kashis_cringey_stuffs)
## Features - Magazine (depth) section unlocked on every device - Extra animal style section - AI dynamic wallpapers on every device - 3 extra clocks in the big clocks section - Lock screen → AOD transition on low-end devices, with jitter fixed - IPS display support - "Always" and "Smart" AOD visibility options - Higher limit on lock screen templates ## Requirements - HyperOS 3 - Magisk, KernelSU or APatch ## Installation 1. Download the latest zip from [**Releases**](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-AOD/releases/latest). 2. Flash it in Magisk, KernelSU or APatch. 3. The module installs in 2 steps to avoid resolution errors. Follow the prompts. 4. Reboot your device. ## Screenshots

HyperOS AOD Mod

The HyperOS Always-on Display and Lock Screen Editor with every feature unlocked on all devices.

![Release](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-AOD/releases/latest)

![Downloads](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-AOD/releases)

![Stars](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-AOD/stargazers)

![Telegram](https://t.me/kashis_cringey_stuffs)

Features

  • Magazine (depth) section unlocked on every device
  • Extra animal style section
  • AI dynamic wallpapers on every device
  • 3 extra clocks in the big clocks section
  • Lock screen → AOD transition on low-end devices, with jitter fixed
  • IPS display support
  • "Always" and "Smart" AOD visibility options
  • Higher limit on lock screen templates

    • Requirements

  • HyperOS 3
  • Magisk, KernelSU or APatch

    • Installation

  • Download the latest zip from [**Releases**](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-AOD/releases/latest).
  • Flash it in Magisk, KernelSU or APatch.
  • The module installs in 2 steps to avoid resolution errors. Follow the prompts.
  • Reboot your device.
